purpose: Define deterministic evidence and first-failure classification for unchanged Debian systemd as PID 1.

required_markers.meaning: systemd and required shared libraries entered through normal Step-31 loader path
required tmpfs/procfs/sysfs/devpts/root mounts reached expected state
selected Step-36 cgroup v2 profile initialized without mandatory missing contract
normal userspace reboot request reached kernel shutdown path cleanly
normal userspace poweroff request reached kernel shutdown path cleanly

first_failure_record.rule: Fix only the first deterministic mandatory failure at the smallest existing owner; do not add a systemd-specific kernel path.

service_selection_rule: Pin three ordinary services available in the exact Debian target before Step-37 PREP becomes PREP_READY; service names must be recorded in the final Step-37 manifest and must not require Kernal-specific unit patches.
runtime_owner_rules: every discovered blocker routes back to Steps 31-36 canonical owners
unsupported optional features use documented Linux-compatible fallback/error behavior
